creator: Manohar Kaul (2013)
projection: Local equirectangular approximation, Earth radius 6371 km, longitude cos(mean latitude). Euclidean distances define the kernel; not geodesic distances.
deduplication: First source row at each exact longitude/latitude retained; held-out location disjoint from training.
model: Chosen ordinary-kriging model on real UCI data; not an unmodified CUTEst or pre-existing QP benchmark.
